authorization_boundary: No Alpha 015 return archive, strategy PnL, development result, or locked-validation result has been acquired or inspected. This amendment is permitted only before Experiment 0015 preregistration.
problem: The immutable base activation policy predates methodology amendment 002 and still describes the superseded 13-minute grid and holding convention.

The methodology audit bound its execution-cost reference to a mutable generic report path. Re-running an unrelated calibration could therefore invalidate or silently alter the pre-registration contract.

Three immutable public-L2 long-entry calibration receipts report descriptive cost floors of 5, 9, and 6 basis points; retaining 5 basis points as the base floor would be less conservative than the worst observed receipt.

cadence.description: Use the already-approved amendment-002 convention: a non-overlapping 10-minute UTC epoch decision grid, a one-minute latency buffer, and a 10-minute holding interval. The superseded 13-minute text remains historical context only.

execution_calibration.source_scope: diagnostic-only public-L2 long-entry calibration; it is not live-promotion evidence

costs.rationale: The base rounds the worst observed 9bp long-entry receipt up to the next conservative 10bp band. The stress cost doubles that conservative base. Neither value grants maker credit or an execution-path pass.

nonchanges: The candidate remains deferred and Experiment 0015 remains unregistered.

The 180 consecutive prior-day point-in-time universe requirement, 120/60 development-validation split, source-bound archive rules, model family, lambda grid, quintile construction, funding accounting, and all gates are unchanged.
No result is selected, discarded, or interpreted by this amendment.
prohibited: acquiring or inspecting returns before activation and preregistration
reducing these costs after observing strategy returns
treating the calibration receipt as complete order-path or live-trading evidence
